title: Lena and the Uniform
author: Paloma Villalobos
blurb: Beatrix Oyelaran, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
